notes.title: Update 1
notes.content:
We've just uploaded an update to Shrug Island - The Meeting. It has the following additions and improvements:


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12089059/60cbcf4ef1cd9dd2524d4290dd9a362cab056783.png

PauseGame/Quit/GotoMenu is now accessible everywhere
Press escape button on your keyboard. This option to was previously accessible only via the map (itself available from the fourth level of the game and onwards).


Dialogue GUI/triangle icon now has states These visualize if the player has or hasn’t accessed all hints at a given moment. Note: More, greyer lines of unread text may still be hidden behind an empty dialogue icon; these are random non-puzzle related story rhymes, and are not counted by the interface.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12089059/38789cf09c1eba582490fc6f183fca0546ef3ec1.png


 Frame rate fix It is now locked at 60 fps.

Various Visual polishing and audio balancing.



We hope you enjoy it.
@TinyRedCamel
